rules.description: Factory is a large share of domain traffic (25–50%).
rules.message: Factory is {domain.dataCache.factoryShare:p1} of {domain.requests} requests — the cache is not absorbing traffic. Check Fusion/Output TTL, key cardinality, and invalidation.

rules.description: Factory dominates domain traffic (≥50%).
rules.message: Factory is {domain.dataCache.factoryShare:p1} of {domain.requests} requests — the cache is not absorbing traffic. Check Fusion/Output TTL, key cardinality, and invalidation.

rules.description: Fail-safe stale share is elevated on a domain.
rules.message: Stale serves {domain.dataCache.staleShare:p1} of requests — fail-safe is covering factory failures. Inspect timeouts and factory/backend health.

rules.description: Many invalidations relative to request volume.
rules.message: {domain.invalidations} invalidations vs {domain.requests} requests — entity-level invalidation may fit better than domain-wide Version bumps.

rules.description: Factory failure rate 10–50% on a domain.
rules.message: Factory failed {domain.dataCache.factoryFailureRate:p1} of {domain.dataCache.factoryRuns} runs. Inspect factory/backend errors; fail-safe may be covering them as stale.

rules.description: Factory failure rate ≥50% on a domain.
rules.message: Factory failed {domain.dataCache.factoryFailureRate:p1} of {domain.dataCache.factoryRuns} runs. Inspect factory/backend errors; fail-safe may be covering them as stale.

rules.description: Client Cache Schedule is in approaching phase.
rules.message: Client Cache Schedule is approaching the cutover — client max-age is ramping down. This is expected.

rules.description: Schedule has been in hold for 24h+ after ScheduledUpdateUtc.
rules.message: Client Cache Schedule has been in hold for {config.holdAgeHours:0.#} hours — set the next ScheduledUpdateUtc or clear the schedule so clients can return to a long max-age.

rules.description: Schedule is in hold (recent cutover).
rules.message: Client Cache Schedule is in hold — set the next ScheduledUpdateUtc when the cutover is done.

rules.description: Client TTL much larger than Output TTL without a schedule.
rules.message: Client TTL ({config.clientTtlSeconds}s) is much larger than Output TTL ({config.outputCacheTtlSeconds}s) — browsers can stay stale after the server cache expires. Use a schedule or align the TTLs.

rules.description: Schedule cannot ramp (min TTL ≥ max TTL).
rules.message: Client min TTL ({config.clientTtlMinSeconds}s) is not below max ({config.clientTtlSeconds}s) — the schedule cannot ramp. Lower ClientTtlMinSeconds or raise ClientTtlSeconds.

rules.description: Fusion hard TTL shorter than soft TTL.
rules.message: Data-cache hard TTL ({config.hardTtlSeconds}s) is shorter than soft ({config.dataCacheTtlSeconds}s) — hard wins. Raise hard or lower soft.

rules.description: Runtime Version/TTL overlay is active.
rules.message: A runtime overlay is in effect (Version and/or TTLs) — persist it in configuration if it should survive process restart.

rules.description: OC hit share varies a lot across instances.
rules.message: OC hit share varies across instances (stdev {domain.instanceSpread.outputCacheHitShare.stdev:p1}) — InMemory OC is not shared, or traffic is uneven.

rules.description: Factory share elevated on an endpoint (25–50%).
rules.message: Factory is {endpoint.dataCache.factoryShare:p1} of requests on this route — factory runs too often.

rules.description: Factory share dominates an endpoint (≥50%).
rules.message: Factory is {endpoint.dataCache.factoryShare:p1} of requests on this route — factory runs too often.

rules.description: Stale share elevated on an endpoint.
rules.message: Stale share {endpoint.dataCache.staleShare:p1} — fail-safe after factory issues.

rules.description: Factory failure rate 10–50% on an endpoint.
rules.message: Factory failed {endpoint.dataCache.factoryFailureRate:p1} of {endpoint.dataCache.factoryRuns} runs on this route.

rules.description: Factory failure rate ≥50% on an endpoint.
rules.message: Factory failed {endpoint.dataCache.factoryFailureRate:p1} of {endpoint.dataCache.factoryRuns} runs on this route.

rules.description: Factory share varies a lot across instances for a route.
rules.message: Factory share differs across instances (stdev {endpoint.instanceSpread.factoryShare.stdev:p1}).

rules.description: Low traffic and low factory cost — limited value from caching this domain.
rules.message: Cache impact looks limited (candidate POOR): low request volume and cheap factory. Avoidance {domain.impact.factoryAvoidance:p0}; avg factory {domain.impact.avgFactoryDurationMs} ms.

rules.description: Expensive factory runs often — cache benefit at risk.
rules.message: Cache benefit AT_RISK: factory share {domain.dataCache.factoryShare:p1}, avg factory {domain.impact.avgFactoryDurationMs} ms. Check TTL, keys, and invalidation.

rules.description: Strong cache impact — high traffic and expensive factory avoided.
rules.message: Strong cache impact: avoidance {domain.impact.factoryAvoidance:p0}, est. factory time saved {domain.impact.estFactoryTimeSavedMs} ms (lifetime).

rules.description: Endpoint is a poor cache candidate (low traffic × low cost).
rules.message: Route impact limited (candidate POOR). Avoidance {endpoint.impact.factoryAvoidance:p0}.
